answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 37280 Country: Canada Title: Please guide me meaning of the name Irha and also how to write in Urdu. Question: Please guide me meaning of the name Irha and also how to write in Urdu. Answer ID: 37280 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 444/444/M=1433) Arha (اَرحاء) (with the zabar of Alif) is an Arabic word that is plural of Raha (رَحَی). It means mill, chest, the part of nail around four sides, jaw (Al-Qamus al-Wahid). Irha (إرحاء) with the zer of Alif I could not find this word in the dictionary. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
